# SYJ LABS

SYJ LABS is the independent technology lab of Syed Ali Hasan Moosavi. It documents practical AI, blockchain, software and automation projects.

Website: https://shalimoosavi.github.io/SYJ-Labs/
Founder: https://shalimoosavi.github.io/moosavi/
GitHub: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi

## SYJ-LLM
Category: AI
Language: C++
Description: Offline-first LLM runtime in C/C++ for low-RAM devices (~4GB). Built on llama.cpp + GGUF with memory-safe budgeting, no cloud, no API keys. Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android, WASM. By SAYANJALI NEXUS.
Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-LLM
Page: https://shalimoosavi.github.io/SYJ-Labs/projects/syj-llm/
Last updated: 2026-09-20
Topics: ai-runtime, edge-ai, gguf, llama-cpp, llm, llm-runtime, local-llm, low-memory, mmap, offline-ai, on-device-ai, open-source-ai
